source_text: International and national campaigns by WHO, UNICEF, and UNFPA since 1997 have promoted evidence-based alternatives, such as skilled antenatal monitoring, timely hospital referrals, and cesarean sections for obstructed labor, reducing reliance on traditional methods by demonstrating superior outcomes in preventing fistulas without invasive vaginal scarring.
